description.value:
Slot none; Price 5,000 gp (lesser), 10,000 gp (normal), 20,000 gp (greater)
Weight 5 lbs.; Feat Cost 1 sp

When you cast a tenebrous talent in darkness or dim light, the spell’s effective caster level is increased by 2 and any associated save DCs are increased by 1. Any attempts at dispelling a tenebrous talent in darkness or dim light take a –2 penalty on the check. Casting a tenebrous talent in bright light is difficult, and requires a concentration check (DC 15 + the tenebrous talent’s effective caster level). Attempts to dispel a tenebrous talent in bright light gain a +4 bonus on the check. You cannot use this effect on talents with the light descriptor.

Construction Requirements
Craft Apparatus, Tenebrous Spell; Cost 2,500 gp (lesser), 5,000 gp (normal), 10,000 gp (greater)

Source: Spheres of Power Wiki
description.instructions:
Selected profile: lesser tier; held slender rod. Apply as part of casting a qualifying sphere effect of caster level seven or lower. Hold this apparatus in at least one hand while applying it. Spend one of three daily uses; only one metamagic apparatus may apply per casting. Its feat's extra spell-point and casting-time costs are waived, but normal effect and other-metamagic costs still apply.

No light-descriptor talents qualify. In darkness or dim light, this talent gains two effective caster levels and one save DC, and dispel attempts take -2. In bright light casting requires concentration DC 15 + its effective caster level, and dispel attempts gain +4. Lighting and effect-specific modifiers must be resolved for the actual casting.

Shared metamagic apparatus rules. Feat Cost applies to taking the feat, not using the physical apparatus.
